titulo_original: Titón, de la Habana a Guantanamera

sinopsis.es: La viuda de Tomás Gutiérrez Alea, 'Titón', recorre la vida y obra del cineasta cubano —de su nacimiento en La Habana hasta Guantanamera— con entrevistas a colegas, familiares y al propio director.
sinopsis.en: Tomás Gutiérrez Alea's widow traces the life and work of the Cuban filmmaker known as 'Titón' —from his birth in Havana to Guantanamera— through interviews with colleagues, family and the director himself.
